SPY.text: SPY fell about 1.5% as the Fed held rates but Chair Kevin Warsh’s inflation-focused remarks pushed long-term yields higher, while a 7% oil spike and renewed AI-stock selling deepened the risk-off move.

QQQ.text: QQQ fell about 2.0% as the AI and semiconductor selloff deepened after SK Hynix’s weak results, while the Fed’s inflation-focused hold and rising long-term yields further pressured expensive growth stocks.
